articles.title: Houthi rebels say they targeted Riyadh financial district
articles.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for drone strikes targeting Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanoura refinery and Riyadh's financial district, while Sudan reported at least 19 deaths in strikes blamed on the RSF. Separately, an Israeli strike killed four members of a family in Gaza, and Jordan sentenced a man to death over a fatal attack on a security officer.
